summary: YPF S.A., an Argentine integrated energy company, filed a Form 6-K reporting a material event: it entered into an agreement to assign its interests in the Mendoza Non-Operated cluster (conventional blocks in Mendoza and La Pampa provinces) to San Benito Upstream S.A.U. The transaction covers YPF's 30.01% stake in CNQ-7 Gobernador Ayala and 50% interests in CNQ-7A and Jagüel Casa de Piedra, including pipelines and warehouse materials. Consideration is US$205 million, effective January 1, 2026, subject to customary conditions precedent, VAT, and closing adjustments. This divestiture aligns with YPF's 4x4 Plan portfolio optimization, redirecting capital toward unconventional fields. Watch for regulatory approvals (CNV, ByMA) and closing adjustments.
